mechanism: Primaquine induces CYP1A2 and other hepatic enzymes, potentially increasing melatonin metabolism and reducing its efficacy; both agents may have additive effects on hemolysis risk in G6PD-deficient patients.
action: Monitor melatonin efficacy if used concurrently; ensure G6PD status is known before primaquine use as melatonin's antioxidant properties may not fully protect against hemolysis.
